view.failedHelp: Previous results are not shown because they may be from different data. Fix the cause and refresh.
view.metricsDescription: Each variation compared with {{control}}. Intervals share one axis.

method.bayesian: Bayesian: chance to win and credible intervals
method.sequential: Sequential test: intervals stay valid however often you check
method.fixed: Fixed-horizon test: valid at the planned sample only

banner.label: Verdict
banner.untrustworthyDetail: {{problem}} Don't make a decision until the cause is fixed; see the health check below.
banner.noPrimary: No result for the primary metric
banner.noPrimaryDetail: The analysis did not include the primary metric. Check that it is still set on the Setup tab.
banner.winningRegressed: {{name}} is winning ({{effect}}), but a guardrail got worse
banner.noDifferenceYet: Too early to call: no difference detected yet
banner.notEnoughData: Too early to call: not enough data yet
banner.notEnoughDataDetail: Keep the experiment running; the verdict appears once each variation has enough users.
banner.significant: A difference this large is unlikely to be chance (significance level {{alpha}}).
banner.estimate: The estimate ({{effect}}) is within the range of chance; treat it as no difference.
banner.early: Early data: don't decide on it yet
banner.earlyDetail: Less than 24 hours in. Weekday and novelty swings are large this early; wait for at least a full day of data.
banner.noPlan: Set a sample size plan to see when it will finish

health.label: Data health
health.srmGeneric: Sample ratio mismatch: users were not split as configured.
health.srmDetail: Sample ratio mismatch: {{name}} got {{observed}} users where {{expected}} were expected.
health.multipleShare: {{percent}} of users saw more than one variation.
health.sampleRatioPending: checked once each variation has users
health.chiSquare: Chi-square test against the configured split. Below p = 0.001 the assignment is broken and results are hidden as a verdict.

causes.crash: A variation crashes, redirects or loads slower, so its exposure is never sent
causes.codePath: Exposures are logged on a code path only one variation reaches (log at flag evaluation instead)
causes.override: A rule above the experiment, a QA override or a cached payload assigns some users outside the split
causes.hashAttribute: The SDK hashes a different attribute than the user id used for analysis (anonymous vs signed-in id)
causes.bots: Bots or internal traffic are concentrated in one variation

health.multipleNote: Users who saw more than one variation are excluded from every metric; above 1% the experiment is flagged.

trend.title: Cumulative lift
trend.description: By first-exposure date. A line that keeps drifting suggests a novelty effect or a tracking change.

waiting.title: Waiting for the first exposures
waiting.description: Results appear once users in {{environment}} evaluate {{flag}}.
waiting.codeTitle: Evaluate the flag with the SDK

assigned.title: Users get assigned
assigned.body: Each user is hashed on "{{attribute}}" into a variation; the same user always gets the same one.

arrive.title: Exposures arrive
arrive.body: The SDK batches exposures to furca. Bots and duplicate exposures are filtered out.

refresh.title: Refresh to analyze
refresh.body: Health checks run first. The verdict appears once each variation has enough users for the primary metric.

chart.tooFewDays: The trend appears after users from at least two days have been analyzed.

table.caption: Metric results by variation compared with {{control}}
table.noComparisons: No comparisons were computed for this metric.

breakdown.title: Breakdown
breakdown.exploratory: Exploratory: slices are not corrected for multiple comparisons. Use them to see where an effect comes from, not to pick a winner.
breakdown.noData: No exposures in the current phase yet.
breakdown.emptyDescription: Breakdowns split results by an attribute such as country or plan. Choose them under Breakdowns when you set up an experiment (see <link>Setup</link>); the SDK then sends their values with every exposure.
breakdown.caption: {{metric}} by attribute value compared with {{control}}

decision.againstShipNotWinning: {{name}} has not been shown to improve the primary metric.
decision.againstShipEarly: The data covers less than 24 hours.
decision.againstUnhealthy: The data failed its health check, so the results can't be trusted.
decision.acknowledge: I understand this goes against the results and explain why below
decision.acknowledgeRequired: Confirm that you are deciding against the results.
decision.explainRequired: Add why you are deciding against the results.
decision.shadowExperiment: This change stops {{name}} from assigning users ({{environment}}).
decision.shadowRule: {{rule}} in {{environment}} will no longer be reached.
decision.shadowHelp: The shipped rule serves everyone who matches its targeting, so rules below it never run. Reorder the flag's rules afterwards if they should still apply.
decision.reviewNote: {{environment}} requires review: another admin applies this when they approve it.
decision.requestedDescription: An admin can approve it from Reviews. Nothing changes until then.

pending.title: Waiting for review: {{action}}
pending.blocked: A review request is pending. Start, traffic changes and stopping are disabled until it is approved or cancelled.
